newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian Socialists approve new draft cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian Socialists approve new draft cabinet.

text.p: Bulgaria's ruling Socialist party on Monday approved a draft Socialist cabinet retaining the outgoing finance, agriculture and energy ministers, despite four weeks of opposition protests to demand a general election.
Prime minister designate Nikolai Dobrev will present the list to President Petar Stoyanov on Tuesday, and it is expected to be voted by parliament on Wednesday.
Miroslav Popov, a member of the party's executive bureau, told reporters the draft was passed by 150 votes to seven, with two votes declared invalid.
U.S.-born Georgi Pirinski, a prominent critic of outgoing premier Zhelu Zhelev and who resigned as foreign minister in November, returns to the foreign ministry.

Dobrev, whose compromise proposal for a coalition appointed by Stoyanov was rejected by the party leadership on Friday, said a one-party cabinet was regrettable but better than no cabinet at all, and he still hoped for dialogue with the opposition.
The vote took place as protesters paralysed the country with strikes and roadblocks in one of the biggest protests since the end of communist rule in 1989.
